channel.title: Pier & Point · Pier 70 Building 2 (Warehouse No. 2)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Pier 70 Building 2 (Warehouse No. 2) (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Building 2 (Warehouse No. 2): The record's text says Pier & Point, not 'the owner', where it names who read or chose the Assessor lots.
item.description: The record's text says Pier & Point, not 'the owner', where it names who read or chose the Assessor lots.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Building 2 (Warehouse No. 2): Pier 70 Building 2 now uses real Assessor lot lines.
item.description: Pier 70 Building 2 now uses real Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 4114009.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Building 2 (Warehouse No. 2): Pier 70 Building 2 was trimmed where it overlapped a neighbouring Assessor lot.
item.description: Pier 70 Building 2 was trimmed where it overlapped a neighbouring Assessor lot. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lots 4114008, 4114004.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Building 2 (Warehouse No. 2): Building 2's map use is now 'mixed' and its text describes the D4D's flexible commercial-office/residential treatment instead of retail/arts/light-industrial, and drops uncited brochure square-footage figures. The summary now says it is an option parcel that must be developed consistent with the Secretary's Standards if the option is exercised, not a building Brookfield must rehabilitate. A hosted D4D page with photos credited to private parties was removed from the record (the D4D stays linked). Image credits no longer say 'adopted 2017' or give an unstated Aug 11 meeting date, and the Item 11A milestone is dated to the Aug 7, 2026 staff report.
item.description: Building 2's map use is now 'mixed' and its text describes the D4D's flexible commercial-office/residential treatment instead of retail/arts/light-industrial, and drops uncited brochure square-footage figures. The summary now says it is an option parcel that must be developed consistent with the Secretary's Standards if the option is exercised, not a building Brookfield must rehabilitate. A hosted D4D page with photos credited to private parties was removed from the record (the D4D stays linked). Image credits no longer say 'adopted 2017' or give an unstated Aug 11 meeting date, and the Item 11A milestone is dated to the Aug 7, 2026 staff report. Source: Port of San Francisco, Pier 70 Special Use District Design for Development, updated 2022-04-26 (https://www.sfport.com/media/8123/download?inline=); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 9B staff report, 2017-09-22 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 11A staff report, 2026-08-07 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/item_11a_p70_project_update_-_term_sheet_overview_-_information.pdf).

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Building 2 (Warehouse No. 2): Warehouse No. 2 moved to its real position beside Buildings 12 and 21. It had been drawn on a vacant lot near Illinois St, 4x too large.
item.description: Warehouse No. 2 moved to its real position beside Buildings 12 and 21. It had been drawn on a vacant lot near Illinois St, 4x too large. Source: Pier 70 D4D, Figures 3.6.1 and 6.4.2.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Building 2 (Warehouse No. 2): Port staff report (memo dated Aug 7, 2026) for the Aug 11, 2026 Port Commission meeting (informational item 11A) proposes a DDA amendment: developer to assign its Building 2 option and close escrow within six months of Board approval of the amendments; certain impact fees and special taxes waived 'given the high costs of historic rehabilitation' (Aug 7, 2026)

Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Building 2 (Warehouse No. 2): Development agreement filing summarized: Building 2 to be rehabilitated into approximately 120 dwelling units (approximately 110,000 gsf) (Oct 27, 2021)
item.description: Development agreement filing summarized: Building 2 to be rehabilitated into approximately 120 dwelling units (approximately 110,000 gsf) (Oct 27, 2021). Source: SF YIMBY (Andrew Nelson), 2021-10-27.
